title: Mitchell 2024 TTX · SEAD team
subtitle: Figure 9: continuous ISR, decoy/jam, strike, harassment and BDA
description: TTX SEAD team's reported 24-hour conceptual cycle, described as persistent ISR, stimulation/decoy and electronic attack, anti-ship/air-defense strike, and sustained electronic attack and bomb damage assessment.
assumptions: Phase names and participating roles follow Figure 9 and pp. 20–21; the report does not provide geolocated tracks or exact phase transition hours.
Figure 9 is a schematic 24-hour concept. The playback duration uses presentation seconds and does not recreate 24 hours of aircraft performance.
The report describes CCA-9, CCA-11, team-modified CCA-12, CCA-4 and CCA-7 as notional variants, not specific currently fielded airframes.
The report's Phase 1 includes EA-37B and RC-135 supporting persistent ISR/electromagnetic effects; the site's generic orbit shape is illustrative.
No tactical geolocation, specific weapons delivery path or outcome is claimed.
